csv_project_name: Conslt for Pleasantview Township Master Plan Update
csv_scope_of_work: Pleasantview Township, located in scenic Emmet County, Michigan, is seeking qualified professional planning consultants to assist the Township in updating its Master Plan in accordance with the Michigan Planning Enabling Act. The updated Master Plan will serve as a legally sound and community-driven blueprint to guide future land use, infrastructure, and policy decisions over the next 10 to 20 years. The selected consultant will be expected to provide the following services: Project Management and Public Engagement, Data Review and Update , Plan Development, Review and Adoption Process
